metadata.title: Strong Uniqueness for Instantaneously Complete Chern-Ricci Flow
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we study strong uniqueness for smooth instantaneously complete Chern-Ricci flows on noncompact complex manifolds. Under suitable reference metric and positivity assumptions, we establish strong uniqueness for initial Hermitian metrics which are Kähler outside a compact set. The initial metric may be incomplete, and no curvature, metric comparison, or growth bounds are imposed on the evolving solutions. In particular, we obtain strong uniqueness from complete initial metrics in this class with bounded Chern-Ricci curvature. We also prove stationarity of flows from the Euclidean metric on $\mathbb{C}^n$ and uniqueness of the instantaneously complete flow from the Euclidean metric on the complex unit ball for all positive time. Finally, on complex surfaces, we show that a Ricci flow remaining Hermitian for a fixed complex structure is Kähler at all times if it is Kähler at one time, and derive a corresponding strong uniqueness result for Ricci flows in this class.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 瞬时完整 Chern-Ricci 流的强唯一性
analysis.workSummary: 在参考度量与正性条件下，对紧集外 Kähler 的 Hermitian 初值证明瞬时完整 Chern-Ricci 流强唯一性；允许不完整初值且不约束演化解曲率和增长，另处理 Euclidean 及复杂曲面 Ricci 流。
analysis.breakthrough: 扩大非紧几何流强唯一性的解类。
analysis.limitations: 演化解无需比较界不等于初值无条件；参考度量、正性与紧集外 Kähler 仍须保留。
analysis.priorityReason: 扩大非紧几何流强唯一性的解类。
